claim: The renderer puts a sprite's bottom at z minus (art yoffset x yrepeat x 4), and adds half its height back only when cstat 128 is set. A tile drawn to be centred (art yofs about half its height: statues, smoke, keys) placed with z on the floor and no cstat 128 hangs in the air by yofs x yrepeat x 4 (statue 536: 0.83 bodies).
evidence: NBlood/source/build/src/engine.cpp:5399-5404 (z2 = z - yoff*yrepeat<<2; += half height if cstat&128) and :12597.
The campaign writes every instance of 536, 754, 672 and 2553 with cstat 128; the owner spotted floating memorial statues in Gravesend that the frames had shown and nobody had seen (2026-11-20).
use: Take a sprite's cstat from a campaign record of the same tile (catalog record), and run tools.sprite_fit, which lists 'lifted' sprites.
